image_ref.description: Sandbox reference to the image. Inline data URLs accepted for small payloads. PDF inputs are rejected — chain through a rasterizer card first.

languages.description: ISO 639-2/T language codes to load (e.g. ['eng'], ['eng','spa']). Each must correspond to an installed Tesseract traineddata file; runner errors on missing packs.

psm.description: Tesseract Page Segmentation Mode. 3 = fully automatic (default), 6 = single uniform block, 7 = single line, 11 = sparse text. Other PSMs available; see Tesseract docs.

include_word_boxes.description: When true, returns per-word bounding boxes alongside the concatenated text. Adds a small amount of latency.

text.description: Concatenated recognized text, with line breaks preserved as emitted by Tesseract. Empty string is a valid 'no text detected' result.

mean_confidence.description: Tesseract's mean per-word confidence over recognized words, on its native 0-100 scale. Absent when no words were recognized.

words.description: Per-word detail. Present only when include_word_boxes=true. Coordinates are absolute pixels in the source image.

engine.description: OCR engine identity and version for receipt citation, e.g. 'tesseract-5.3.4'.

summary: Optical character recognition via locally installed Tesseract; multi-language with optional per-word bounding boxes.
